description: A free civic wayfinder for London public services. Hand-maintained here from this repo's single source of truth for workflow metadata (usecases/*.json, shared/usecaseCatalog.ts) — open an issue at https://github.com/qte77/ldnmxx-hack if this drifts.

skills.title: Sort My Care
skills.description: Find NHS and public health services near a postcode — GPs, pharmacies, hospitals, dentists.

skills.title: Sort My Wander
skills.description: Find parks, green spaces and listed heritage sites to explore near a postcode.

skills.title: Sort My Food Hygiene
skills.description: Look up official food hygiene ratings for restaurants and takeaways near a postcode.

skills.title: Sort My Scam Check
skills.description: Check whether a firm is on the FCA's register of authorised financial businesses.
skills.example: is Thames Capital Partners a scam

skills.title: Sort My Route
skills.description: Plan a step-free public transport route between two London places. Demo only — canned, not backed by a live transport API.

skills.title: Founder's Copilot
skills.description: A demo copilot matching London startup founders to funding and incorporation steps. Demo only.
skills.example: an AI copilot for London founders
